title: The Practical Guide to LLMOps
subtitle: 6-Day Hands-On LLMOps
description: Capacity-plan a serving cluster with back-of-envelope math, stand up vLLM on a real GPU box, fine-tune with LoRA/QLoRA/DPO, and build the eval and drift-detection pipelines that keep a model trustworthy in production — the operational skills between a checkpoint and a reliable endpoint.
